title: Visible ImmersiveOres
description: Make ImmersiveOres raw ores easier to see in caves.
body:
Makes ores from ImmersiveOres more Visible.

This is just a personal mod i wanted to upload since ive had issues where i would find these rare ores but completely miss them, but with this you wont! It will make them obvious to locate and mine. Enjoy!
